# Poly Haven surface assets

Source pages:
- https://polyhaven.com/a/sandy_gravel_02
- https://polyhaven.com/a/dry_riverbed_rock

All supplied asset maps are CC0: https://polyhaven.com/license

Downloaded through the public Poly Haven API for this local prototype. Runtime uses local files and does not call the API. Original 1K maps retained unmodified; the scene tints the materials to the chosen planetary palette. Color maps use sRGB; GL normal, roughness and AO maps are linear data. See manifest.json for exact URLs and hashes.
